question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"reasons"** refers to explanations or justifications for why something is done or why it occurs. (कारण)

 
 
• **Example: **There are several reasons why people might choose to move to a new country, including better job opportunities and a higher standard of living.
 
 
 
• **Reasons** in this context means the various motivations people have for traveling. (प्रेरणाएँ)
 
 
• **Example: **Jane listed her reasons for traveling: to explore new cultures, meet new people, and escape her routine life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option (3) **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Measures** (उपाय): Steps taken or actions implemented to achieve a particular end.

 
 
• **Example:** The government has introduced new measures to combat climate change.
 
 
 
• **Cases** (मामले): Instances or examples of a particular situation or occurrence.
 
 
• **Example: ** In some cases, traveling abroad can be more affordable than domestic vacations.
 
 
 
• **Pretexts** (बहाने): Reasons given in justification of a course of action that are not the actual reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** He used a business trip as a pretext to visit his old friend.
